records.action: Handled the empty finite subset separately before choosing a largest stage index in the Lindenbaum consistency proof.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof chooses the largest of the finitely many stage indices associated with members of Gamma-prime, but a finite subset may be empty and then has no such largest index.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நிறுவல் வெற்றுக் கணத்தின் முரணின்மையை முதலில் தனியே கூறி, வெற்றற்ற இறுதிக்குட்பட்ட உட்கணத்திற்கே மீப்பெரிய சுட்டெண்ணைத் தேர்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Silently assuming the finite subset is nonempty; assigning an arbitrary stage to the empty subset without saying so.
records.rationale: The empty subset is consistent trivially. Every nonempty finite subset has finitely many associated natural-number indices and therefore a largest one, after which the source argument applies unchanged.
records.precise_review_question: Does the explicit empty-set case close the only gap before the maximum-index argument without changing the compactness step?

records.action: Used B rather than A in the universal truth-lemma induction conclusion.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The universal induction case is stated for forall-x B(x), and every preceding satisfaction and membership formula uses B, but its final membership formula unexpectedly switches to A.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நிறுவல் தொகுத்தறிதல் வழக்கின் வாய்பாடு B-ஐ இறுதி அனைத்தளவையிட்ட உறுப்பியச் சூத்திரத்திலும் தொடர்ந்து பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Preserving the isolated A despite the induction case and saturation proposition both using B.
records.rationale: The induction variable A names the whole formula, while B is its immediate quantified subformula; the truth-lemma conclusion must be membership of forall-x B(x).
records.precise_review_question: Does replacing A by B in the final universal-membership formula restore the stated induction case without changing its quantifier or set?

records.rationale: The two explicit uses of zero require a sentinel exception; all positive-label path behavior remains unchanged.
records.precise_review_question: Does the added zero-label disjunct prevent false discharge while preserving the ancestor check for labeled assumptions?

records.action: Added the missing bounded existential j<i around the QR_1 definition.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The QR_1 formula refers to line index j in the bound on c and in (d)_j but never binds j, although the preceding five-item account explicitly requires some line j<i.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடு j<i என்ற வரம்புள்ள இருத்தலளவையீட்டை வெளிப்புறமாகச் சேர்த்து, அதன் முழு உட்பரப்பில் j ஐப் பிணைக்கிறது.

records.action: Made the three-argument hCond step recurse through hCond rather than the two-argument wrapper Cond.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The step clause calls Cond with three arguments even though the next line defines Cond as the two-argument wrapper and hCond as the three-argument recursion helper.

records.rationale: The base clause, step left side and wrapper equation uniquely determine hCond as the recursive helper. The expected display pair also contains the separately audited TA-INC-013 membership repair in the same align environment.
records.precise_review_question: Does the recursive step now reduce n while the public two-argument Cond definition remain unchanged?

records.action: Replaced meta-level membership in Gamma inside the Prf definition with the stated primitive-recursive predicate R_Gamma.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof begins by naming R_Gamma(y) as the primitive-recursive test for membership in Gamma, but the final displayed definition reverts to the unanalyzed expression (s)_i in Gamma.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இறுதி வரையறை ஒவ்வொரு முன்னிலைக் குறியீட்டுக்கும் R_Gamma((s)_i) ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.

records.rationale: Substitution of the already supplied characteristic predicate is exactly what establishes primitive recursiveness.
records.precise_review_question: Does the final bounded universal now invoke R_Gamma on each sequence entry and preserve every other Prf conjunct?

records.action: Changed the lemma's witness formula from A to A_f so it agrees with the displayed biconditional and every use in the proof.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The lemma introduces A(x_0,...,x_k,y), but its display and the entire proof use A_f for the same representing formula.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் துணைத்தேற்றம் தொடக்கத்திலிருந்தே பிரதிநிதித்துவ வாய்பாட்டை A_f என்று பெயரிட்டு, காட்டலின் முழுவதும் அதே பெயரைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Changing every later A_f to A; preserving two names for one witness without an equality or renaming clause.
records.rationale: The subscript records dependence on f and is already fixed by the preceding definition, displayed equivalence and all subsequent proof steps.
records.precise_review_question: Does one formula name A_f now denote the witness consistently in the lemma, display and proof?

records.action: Restored the missing Q-proves prefix before the universal uniqueness formula supplied by representability clause (b).
records.source_issue_or_choice: Representability clause (b) says that Q proves the uniqueness formula, but the proof quotes only the bare formula and then needs it as a Q-theorem to infer Q proves numeral equality.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் தனித்தன்மை வாய்பாட்டுக்கு முன் Q நிறுவுகிறது என்பதை மீட்டமைத்து, அடுத்த தருக்கப் படியின் கோட்பாட்டு உட்பரப்பைப் பாதுகாக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating the uniqueness formula as a metatheoretic assumption; omitting the later conclusion that Q proves the equality.
records.rationale: The cited definition and the next inference independently require the formula to be derivable in Q, not merely displayed at the meta-level.
records.precise_review_question: Is the uniqueness formula now explicitly a theorem of Q, making the subsequent equality derivation valid?

records.action: Wrapped the decoded output (s)_1 in the numeral constructor in the informal explanation of the searched proof pair.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The relation immediately above substitutes num((s)_1) into the object-language formula through A(...,(s)_1), but the explanatory sentence inserts the meta-level number (s)_1 directly as its final term.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் விளக்கம் குறிவிலக்கப்பட்ட வெளியீடு (s)_1 க்கான எண்ணுருவையே வாய்பாட்டின் இறுதி உட்பொருளாக இடுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving a meta-level number in an object-language formula; removing numeral constructors from the preceding definition and substitution function.
records.rationale: The definition of A and the relation R uniquely determine the syntactic formula whose proof code is being searched.
records.precise_review_question: Does the searched derivation now end in the formula containing the numeral for (s)_1, consistent with A and R?

records.action: Changed the introductory function signature from h(x, vector z) to h(vector x, y), matching both primitive-recursion equations and all subsequent occurrences.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The prose names h(x, vector z), while the immediately following base and step equations, the beta-coded sequence and the final extraction all define h(vector x, y).
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் அறிமுகம் இரு வரையறைச் சமன்பாடுகளிலும் தொடர்ந்து வரும் அதே உட்பொருட்களான வெக்டர் x மற்றும் y ஐக் கொண்ட h ஐப் பெயரிடுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Changing every equation and later construction to x and vector z; preserving an unexplained switch in arity and argument roles.
records.rationale: The base variable y=0, successor step y+1 and final beta extraction uniquely determine the intended signature.
records.precise_review_question: Does h now have the same vector parameters and recursion variable everywhere in the lemma and proof?

records.action: Localized the bare English cases entry 'otherwise' as Tamil text inside the display.

records.action: Replaced the circular middle line with the equality derived from the induction hypothesis, then made the last line the desired conclusion by transitivity.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen induction display labels the desired conclusion itself as following from the induction hypothesis, then derives the intermediate equality from that conclusion and Q5. This reverses the two required steps and makes the reasoning circular.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் தொகுத்தறிதல் எடுகோளிலிருந்து நடுச் சமத்துவத்தை முதலில் பெற்று, அதை step5 உடன் சேர்த்து வேண்டிய சமத்துவத்தை இறுதியில் முடிவுசெய்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping the circular order; adding a separate duplicate derivation while leaving the false justification in place.
records.rationale: Q5 gives the first equality, the induction hypothesis together with successor congruence gives the middle equality, and transitivity then uniquely yields the target.
records.precise_review_question: Do step5 and step6 now compose in the stated order to yield exactly the induction target?

records.action: Changed the prose witness generalized in the trichotomy proof from c-prime to c.
records.source_issue_or_choice: From (c-prime + b-prime) = numeral(m)-prime, the required Q8 witness formula is (u-prime + b-prime) = numeral(m+1). Substitution therefore uses u=c, whereas generalizing on the whole term c-prime would yield u+b-prime instead.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் c மீது இருத்தலளவைப் பொதுமைப்படுத்துகிறது; அப்போது u-prime இடத்தில் c-prime கிடைத்து வேண்டிய Q8 நேர்வு அமைகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Generalizing on c-prime as printed; changing Q8 or the preceding equality.
records.rationale: The syntactic substitution instance of the existential formula uniquely identifies c as the witness term.
records.precise_review_question: Does existential introduction now substitute c for u so that u-prime reproduces the established c-prime term?

records.action: Restored the statement that h is defined from f and g by primitive recursion before invoking the lemma that eliminates primitive recursion.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The cited lemma applies to the function h defined from f and g by primitive recursion, but the frozen sentence merely says h is defined from f and g and thus omits the construction being eliminated.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் h ஆனது f மற்றும் g இலிருந்து முதன்மை மீள்வரையறையால் வரையறுக்கப்படுகிறது என்பதை வெளிப்படையாக மீட்டமைக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving the construction unspecified; weakening the cited lemma into a false claim about every function definable from f and g.
records.rationale: The preceding characterization and the cited primitive-recursion simulation lemma uniquely supply the omitted construction.
records.precise_review_question: Does the sentence now state exactly which primitive-recursive construction is replaced by composition and regular minimization?

records.action: Qualified the converse representability claim and the final comparison of axiomatizable theories by consistency.
records.source_issue_or_choice: A computable derivation system alone does not ensure that every represented function is computable: an inconsistent axiomatizable theory proves every graph formula and its uniqueness clause, so every function becomes representable under the stated definition.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் விளக்கம் கணிக்கத்தக்க வருவித்தல் முறையுடன் முரணின்மையையும் கோருகிறது; இறுதி அடிகோளாக்கத்தக்க கோட்பாடுகள் பற்றிய கூற்றிலும் அதே தகுதியைச் சேர்க்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining the overclaim; silently assuming consistency without stating it; redefining representability.
records.rationale: The immediately preceding proof that representability yields computability explicitly uses consistency, and the standard examples Q, PA and ZF are intended under that same qualification.
records.precise_review_question: Do both general claims now exclude inconsistent derivation systems while preserving the intended comparison across Q, PA and ZF?

records.action: Changed the numeral proved equal to t_2 from n to m, its stipulated value in the standard model.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof fixes n as the value of t_1 and m as the value of t_2, but then says Q proves t_2 equals numeral n before splitting into the n=m and n-not-equal-m cases.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் t_2 ஐ அதன் நிலைப்படுத்தப்பட்ட மதிப்பான m இன் எண்குறிக்குச் சமப்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping numeral n, which assumes the equality case before the case distinction; renaming both fixed values.
records.rationale: The closed-term lemma applied to t_2 uniquely yields its own value m.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected pair of equalities now support both the equality and inequality cases?

records.action: Changed the closed numeral equality from n plus successor k to successor k plus n so it matches the Q8 witness formula used in the next inference.
records.source_issue_or_choice: Q8 defines x<y using z-prime plus x, but the frozen proof establishes n plus k-prime and then swaps the addends without deriving commutativity in Q.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் மூடிய சொல் துணைத்தேற்றத்தை நேரடியாக k-prime plus n என்ற வரிசையில் பயன்படுத்தி, அடுத்த Q8 நேர்வுடன் பொருந்தச் செய்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Assuming unproved global commutativity in Q; adding a separate commutativity lemma not available here.
records.rationale: Both closed terms have value m, so atomic completeness directly proves the correctly ordered equality without any commutativity principle.
records.precise_review_question: Does substituting t_1 for numeral n now yield exactly successor witness plus t_1 equals t_2?

records.action: Changed both contradiction citations from Q3 to Q2, the axiom that no successor equals zero.
records.source_issue_or_choice: Both contradictions have the form successor equals zero. Q2 states x-prime is not zero, whereas Q3 states that every nonzero number is a successor.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரண்டு முரண்பாட்டுப் படிகளிலும் வழிவரு சுழிக்குச் சமமல்ல என்று கூறும் Q_2 ஐச் சுட்டுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining Q3; changing the contradiction formulas to fit Q3.
records.rationale: The displayed contradictions instantiate Q2 directly and do not instantiate Q3.
records.precise_review_question: Do both axiom citations now justify the exact successor-equals-zero contradictions displayed?

records.action: Changed empty disjunction to empty conjunction in the zero-bound base case for the bounded universal formula.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The lemma's first clause expands a bounded universal formula into a finite conjunction, and at bound zero that conjunction is true; the frozen proof instead calls it an empty disjunction while assigning it the truth constant.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் அனைத்தளவை நேர்வுக்குரிய வெற்று இணைப்பை மெய் மாறிலியாக எடுத்துக்கொள்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping empty disjunction while calling it true; switching to the existential clause.
records.rationale: An empty conjunction is true and is exactly the k=0 instance of the conjunction on the right side of clause one.
records.precise_review_question: Does the base case now name the same Boolean operation used in the lemma's universal clause?

records.action: Wrapped A(x) as the second argument of the bounded existential macro under negation.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The bounded existential macro requires a bound argument and a matrix argument, but the frozen expression leaves A(x) outside the macro braces.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வெளிப்பாடு A(x) ஐ வரம்பிட்ட இருத்தலளவை மேட்ரிக்சாக இரண்டாம் கட்டளையுருப்பில் வைக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving the matrix outside the macro; rewriting the bounded quantifier in expanded ordinary-existential form.
records.rationale: The companion bounded formulas throughout the section and the stated macro convention fix the intended two-argument syntax.
records.precise_review_question: Is A(x) now scoped by the bounded existential quantifier exactly as required by the duality step?

records.action: Changed the opening Sigma-one witness formula in the final proof to the documented two-optional-argument lexists syntax.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The final proof begins with lexists using a mandatory brace argument followed by an unscoped formula, while the definition and concluding line use the documented optional variable and matrix arguments.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இறுதிக் காட்டல் வரையறையிலும் முடிவிலும் உள்ள அதே lexists[x][A(x)] வடிவைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping malformed syntax; altering the definition and conclusion to match it.
records.rationale: The macro declaration and every surrounding well-formed occurrence uniquely determine the intended syntax and scope.
records.precise_review_question: Does the proof now begin and end with the same well-scoped Sigma-one existential sentence?

records.action: Added the missing opening parenthesis before the fourth list-item reference.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The fourth item ends its theorem reference with a closing parenthesis but has no matching opening parenthesis, unlike the preceding three parallel items.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நான்காம் பட்டியல் உறுப்பிலும் மேற்கோளைப் பொருந்திய அடைப்புக்குறிகளுக்குள் வைக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Deleting the unmatched closing parenthesis; preserving inconsistent punctuation.
records.rationale: The three preceding items and the identical syntactic role of the fourth reference fix the intended punctuation.
records.precise_review_question: Does the fourth theorem reference now follow the same balanced pattern as the other three?

records.action: Replaced two uses of the formula metavariable A_x applied to x with the indexed partial-computation notation cfind_x(x) defined.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The diagonal halting set K was defined earlier by definedness of the indexed partial function cfind_x(x), but this proof twice applies a down-arrow to the logical formula metavariable A_x.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் K இன் முன் வரையறையிலுள்ள சுட்டெண் சார்பின் வரையறுக்கப்பட்ட தன்மைக் குறிமுறையையே இரு இடங்களிலும் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating A_x as an unexplained program notation; redefining K locally with a formula.
records.rationale: The cited many-one completeness result and Kleene T equivalence both concern the established self-halting set.
records.precise_review_question: Do the definition of K and the converse conclusion now use the same indexed-computation notation?

records.action: Replaced both final occurrences of the metatheoretic Kleene predicate T inside the claimed Q sentence with its representing formula A_T.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof introduces A_T as the arithmetic formula representing Kleene's external relation T and uses it throughout the reduction, but the final summary and coded sentence revert to T with numeral arguments.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் Q நிறுவும் வாக்கியத்திலும் அதன் குறியீட்டைத் தரும் சார்பிலும் பிரதிநிதித்துவ வாய்பாடு A_T ஐ வைத்திருக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Adding T as an unexplained symbol to the language of arithmetic; replacing the earlier representation proof with a richer language.
records.rationale: Only A_T belongs to the stated language and is the formula whose Q-provability was established immediately above.
records.precise_review_question: Does the reduction function now code exactly the arithmetic sentence proved equivalent to self-halting?

records.action: Changed both evaluations of the external relation S from the object-language numeral for n to the natural number n.
records.source_issue_or_choice: S is introduced as a computable relation on natural numbers, while D_S is its object-language representing formula. The two equivalence displays apply S itself to numeral n rather than n.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மேக்கோட்பாட்டு S ஐ n இல் மதிப்பிட்டு, D_S க்கு மட்டும் எண்குறி num n ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating S as an object-language predicate symbol; removing numeral constructors from D_S.
records.rationale: The definition of relation representability fixes the separation between external inputs and internal numeral terms.
records.precise_review_question: Do both positive and negative equivalences now distinguish S(n) from D_S(num n)?

records.action: Changed the simultaneous proof searches from the whole theory T to its stipulated computable axiom set A.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof assumes a computable axiom set A but then tells the algorithm to search for a derivation from T, whose membership is exactly what the algorithm is meant to decide.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் படிமுறை கணிக்கத்தக்க அடிகோள் கணம் A இலிருந்து இரு வருவித்தல்களையும் தேடுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Using T as an oracle; assuming the theorem set is already decidable.
records.rationale: Effective enumeration of derivations from A is supplied by axiomatizability and is the premise needed for the dovetailed search.
records.precise_review_question: Does the algorithm now rely only on the computable axiom set rather than presupposing theorem membership?

records.action: Rendered the proof premise as axiomatizable, matching both the theorem statement and the immediately preceding decidability lemma; retained the frozen token key in an alignment comment.

records.action: Changed the proof's final description from subsets of s(Z) to subsets of s(X).

records.rationale: Pow(Y,R,X) explicitly says that Y codes the powerset of X, so the final injectivity condition associates Y-elements with subsets of X.
records.precise_review_question: Does the final proof sentence now describe the same X-parametrized powerset coding relation as the displayed formula?

records.action: Restricted both comparison formulas' injectivity requirement to arguments in X.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen formulas demand that a total ambient-domain function be injective everywhere, which is stronger than the stated existence of an injection from X to Y and can fail solely because the complement of X is too large.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடுகள் u இன் மதிப்புகள் X இலிருந்து Y க்குச் செல்கின்றன என்றும், X இல் உள்ள உள்ளீடுகள்மீது மட்டும் u உட்செலுத்துவதாகும் என்றும் கூறுகின்றன.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping global injectivity; introducing partial-function semantics absent from the chapter.
records.rationale: A total second-order function variable can represent an injection with restricted domain X exactly by guarding both injectivity arguments with X membership.
records.precise_review_question: Do both corrected formulas now characterize |X|≤|Y| and |X|=|Y| without constraints on u outside X?

records.action: Required the witness to map X into X and to be injective only on X.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen formula makes u globally injective but never requires values of X-elements to remain in X, so it does not state that u is an injective nonsurjective self-map of X.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடு X இன் கீழ் மூடுதலையும் X-இல் கட்டுப்படுத்தப்பட்ட உட்செலுத்துதலையும் சேர்த்து டெடெகிண்ட் முடிவிலாதன்மையைத் துல்லியமாகக் கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining global injectivity with no closure; treating u as partial despite standard function-variable semantics.
records.rationale: The preceding domain-level criterion requires exactly an injective nonsurjective map X→X.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected formula hold exactly when s(X) has an injective nonsurjective self-map?

records.action: Closed the outer implication before closing its universal quantifier.

records.action: Restricted the prohibited injection to the coded powerset domain Y.

records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடு Y இல் உள்ள இரு உள்ளீடுகளுக்கே உட்செலுத்துதலைக் கோருகிறது.

records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected sentence rule out every injection Y→X represented by a total ambient function?

records.action: Required unique subset codes and a bijection from the entire domain onto their coding set Y.

records.precise_review_question: Do unique codes plus the range, injectivity and surjectivity clauses prove exactly |Domain(M)|=|R|?

records.precise_review_question: Is the corrected countermodel typed consistently as an ordered model triple?

records.action: Restored the omitted world argument on the boxed satisfaction claim in the seriality contradiction.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The paired Diamond satisfaction claim and the implication failure are both explicitly evaluated at w, but the preceding Box claim alone omits its world parameter.

records.precise_review_question: Are both modal satisfaction claims in the seriality contradiction now evaluated at the same world w?

records.action: Changed the induction-case input under prvTrue from the false constant to the true constant.

records.action: Moved the prose-closing parenthesis outside the inline formula defining the arbitrary valuation example.

records.action: Restored 'normal' in the proposition asserting the least modal logic containing the stated schema instances.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proposition says only 'modal logic', but its proof takes the intersection of normal modal logics and the immediately following definition identifies the result as the smallest normal modal logic.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் கூற்றில் மிகச்சிறிய இயல்பான வாய்ப்புநிலைத் தருக்கம் என்று வெளிப்படையாகக் கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping the weaker proposition while presenting a proof of a stronger and differently defined result; weakening the proof and following definition.
records.rationale: Normality is essential to the construction and is explicitly used on both sides of the proposition.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected proposition now state the same normal-modal-logic result that its proof establishes?

records.action: Restored the K axiom-schema macro in the membership conclusion of the normality proof.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The premise proves the axiom schema Ax{K}, but the conclusion changes it to an unrelated plain formula letter K before asserting membership in Sigma.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நிறுவல் முன்னுறுப்பிலும் உறுப்புச் சேர்க்கை முடிவிலும் ஒரே அடிகோள் திட்டவடிவம்~$\Ax{K}$ ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining plain K as though it were a modal formula; changing the preceding provability claim away from the axiom schema.
records.rationale: The proof is establishing that the set of derivable formulas contains the K schema required for normality.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected membership line retain the same K axiom schema proved immediately before it?

records.action: Restored the formula metavariable sigil on B in the rewriting proposition's conclusion.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The hypothesis relates formula metavariables !A and !B, and every surrounding substitution uses formula metavariables, but the conclusion alone writes plain B.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மீளெழுதுதல் கூற்றின் முடிவில் முன்னுறுப்பிலுள்ள அதே வாய்பாட்டு மீமாறி~$!B$ ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating plain B as a distinct object despite the stated A/B equivalence; dropping the sigil from every other occurrence.
records.rationale: The proposition substitutes equivalent modal formulas into the same context, so both substitution arguments must be formula metavariables.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected conclusion substitute the same formula !B introduced by the equivalence hypothesis?

records.action: Changed the prose abbreviation from 'A for B' to 'B for A' so it matches the displayed transformation from C(A) to C(B).
records.source_issue_or_choice: The displayed derivation starts with C(A) and ends with C(B), and the subsequent worked example says 'p for double-negation' when replacing double-negation by p; the general label states the opposite order.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் $!C(!A)$ ஐ~$!C(!B)$ ஆக மாற்றுவதை “$!B$ for $!A$” என்று குறிக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping the reversed label despite the display and worked example; reversing the actual derivation instead.
records.rationale: The replacement shorthand must name the inserted formula first and the replaced formula second, as the chapter's own concrete example does.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected shorthand now agree with both C(A)-to-C(B) and the later p-for-double-negation example?

records.action: Changed the cited derivability premise from a modal system named D to the D axiom schema.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The cited result states that KT derives the D axiom schema, but this proof changes its object to a logic-system macro.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உட்கண நிறுவலில் மேற்கோள் காட்டப்பட்ட அதே அடிகோள் திட்டவடிவம்~$\Ax{D}$ ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating a modal system as the object of the formula-derivability relation; altering the cited result.
records.rationale: Deriving the D schema is exactly what lets every KD theorem be reproduced in KT.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected premise derive the D axiom schema rather than a system named D?

records.action: Changed the two theorem conclusions from systems named 4 and 5 to axiom schemata 4 and 5.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof supplies countermodels to instances of Ax4 and Ax5, whereas the theorem statement applies formula non-derivability notation to Log4 and Log5.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் தேற்றத்தில் வருவிக்கப்படாத பொருள்களை~$\Ax{4}$, $\Ax{5}$ என்ற அடிகோள் திட்டவடிவங்களாக எழுதுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping logic systems as arguments of formula derivability; changing the proof into a claim about unnamed systems.
records.rationale: The following two satisfaction failures directly refute the displayed axiom instances and thereby their schemata.
records.precise_review_question: Does the theorem now state non-derivability of Ax4 and Ax5, matching its countermodels?

records.action: Changed the Ax4 counterexample from the generic arrow command to the chapter's object-language conditional.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The theorem and every other instance of Ax4 use the object-language connective lif, but this one countermodel display alone uses to.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எதிர்மாதிரி வாய்பாட்டிலும்~$\lif$ என்ற அதே பொருள்மொழி இணைப்பியைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving a different arrow command in the same axiom schema; changing all Ax4 displays to the generic arrow.
records.rationale: The satisfaction claim must evaluate an instance of the formally defined Ax4 schema.
records.precise_review_question: Is the falsified formula now exactly an Ax4 instance using the established conditional?

records.action: Restored the visible emphasized Rule T label and expressed the omitted conditional relation in the translated item.
records.source_issue_or_choice: A percent sign after the item label comments out both the intended emphasized 'Rule T' heading and the word 'If', leaving the list item without its named property or conditional introduction.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உருப்படியில்~\emph{விதி T} என்ற தலைப்பை வெளிப்படுத்தி, முன்னுறுப்புகளை நிபந்தனை வாக்கியமாக எழுதுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Preserving the accidental hidden heading and malformed prose; deleting the corresponding rule from the property list.
records.rationale: The following paragraph cites this item as a named rule, and its displayed premises and conclusion plainly form a conditional claim.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected fifth item visibly state Rule T as a conditional derivability property?

records.action: Changed the first connective in the Rule T tautological instance to the chapter's object-language conditional.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The nested object-language conditional uses lif at every later level, but the outermost connective alone uses the generic arrow command.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மெய்ம நிகழ்வின் வெளிப்புறத்திலும் உட்புறங்களிலும்~$\lif$ ஐ ஒரேபடியாகப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining mixed connective commands in one recursively nested formula; replacing every inner connective with the generic arrow.
records.rationale: Rule T relies on one nested formula built from the formally defined object-language conditional.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected Rule T tautology use lif at every conditional level?

records.action: Changed the first deduction-theorem conclusion to the chapter's object-language conditional.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The paired deduction-theorem conclusion and the tautological instance immediately below use lif, but the first conclusion alone uses the generic arrow command.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு கழித்தல்-தேற்ற முடிவுகளிலும்~$\lif$ என்ற அதே பொருள்மொழி இணைப்பியைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving one of the paired conclusions in a different notation; changing the paired conclusion and tautological instance to the generic arrow.
records.rationale: Both assumptions are discharged by the same deduction theorem and feed the same object-language tautology.
records.precise_review_question: Do both deduction-theorem conclusions now use the conditional required by the following tautology?

records.action: Removed the redundant Sigma premise set from the non-derivability side of the consistency equivalence while retaining Sigma as the modal-system index.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The surrounding claim concerns theoremhood relative to modal system Sigma and consistency of the singleton premise A, but the parenthetical equivalence alone also inserts Sigma itself as a premise set.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் $\Proves/[\Sigma] \lnot !A$ என்பதையும் $!A \Proves/[\Sigma] \lfalse$ என்பதையும் ஒப்பிட்டு, Sigma-வை முறைமைச் சுட்டியாக மட்டும் வைத்திருக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating every axiom formula in Sigma as an additional premise despite their already being derivable in the indexed system; changing the singleton-consistency side.
records.rationale: The immediately preceding and following sentences use empty-premise Sigma-relative theoremhood, and the cited consistency definition makes A consistent exactly when A does not derive false in that same system.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected equivalence compare empty-premise Sigma-relative non-theoremhood with consistency of A?

records.action: Changed the completeness consequence from A in Gamma to not-A in Gamma when A is absent.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The second half of the negation biconditional assumes A is absent but concludes A is present, contradicting both completeness and the stated result.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் $!A \notin \Gamma$ எனில் நிறைவால் $\lnot !A \in \Gamma$ என்று முடிக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping the direct contradiction as the claimed consequence of completeness; reversing the stated biconditional.
records.rationale: Completeness requires that each formula or its negation belongs to Gamma, so absence of A forces membership of not-A.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected reverse direction conclude membership of not-A from absence of A?

records.action: Changed the converse assumption from absence of A-implies-B to absence of A-iff-B.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof is the converse direction of the biconditional-membership clause and immediately infers membership of not-(A iff B), but its assumption names only A implies B.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மறுதிசை வாதத்தை $!A \liff !B \notin \Gamma$ என்ற பொருத்தமான கருதுகோளுடன் தொடங்குகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping a conditional premise that cannot yield the next negated biconditional; rewriting the entire proof as a conditional-only result.
records.rationale: Completeness turns absence of the exact formula A iff B into membership of its negation, which is the premise used in the remaining argument.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected converse assume absence of the same biconditional whose negation is used next?

records.action: Changed both final nested-premise indices from n to k, matching the declared finite list B1 through Bk.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof introduces premises B1 through Bk and later confirms Box B1 through Box Bk are in Box Gamma, but the two intervening nested conditionals unexpectedly end with Bn.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முன்வைக்கப்பட்ட இறுதிக்குட்பட்ட பட்டியலுக்கு ஏற்ப இரு தொடர் உட்கிடைப்புகளையும்~$!B_k$ இல் முடிக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Renaming the declared premise bound and every surrounding occurrence from k to n; retaining an undeclared relationship between n and k.
records.rationale: Rule RK lifts the same finite premise sequence used by the definition of derivability, so its final index must stay k throughout.
records.precise_review_question: Do the premise conditional and its boxed RK image now end at the declared final premise Bk?

records.action: Restored the Sigma index on the derivability result obtained by applying the preceding lemma.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The hypothesis, cited box-lifting lemma and monotonicity conclusion all concern derivability in arbitrary modal system Sigma, but the intermediate conclusion alone drops that index.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இடைநிலை முடிவிலும்~$\Proves[\Sigma]$ ஐத் தொடர்ந்து பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Reading the unindexed relation as an unexplained change to the minimal system; dropping Sigma from the hypothesis and conclusion as well.
records.rationale: Applying lem:box1 to a Sigma-indexed derivation preserves that same system, which monotonicity then carries to Gamma.
records.precise_review_question: Does every derivability relation in the second box lemma remain indexed by the same Sigma?

records.action: Closed the parenthetical sentence that gives the number of accessibility relations on n worlds.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The parenthesis opened before the precise count 2^(n^2) is never closed.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எண்ணிக்கைக் கூற்றை முடிக்கும் வலப்புற அடைப்புக்குறியைச் சேர்க்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving the parenthetical sentence visibly unclosed.
records.rationale: The missing mark is ordinary punctuation and the next paragraph begins a new argument.
records.precise_review_question: Does the added closing parenthesis terminate only the accessibility-relation count?

records.action: Replaced the incoherent existential claim about some world satisfying Box B with the universal semantic clause that every world satisfies B, and described the toy case as universal accessibility.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The toy argument says Box B holds at w iff some v satisfies Box B, while the immediately following Box induction step quantifies over every equivalence class and requires B itself at each representative.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எல்லா உலகங்களையும் அணுகும் எளிய நேர்வாக இதை வெளிப்படுத்தி, ஒவ்வொரு v-இலும் B மெய்யாகும் என்ற பெட்டி வாய்பாட்டின் சரியான நிபந்தனையைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining the circular existential clause; treating the relation as empty, which would make the later induction step inapplicable.
records.rationale: For universal accessibility, Box B at any world is equivalent to B at every world; this is exactly the premise used later to transfer truth between all classes and representatives.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected toy clause state universal accessibility and evaluate unboxed B at every world?

records.action: Retained the frozen valuation formulas and recorded that, as written, they include binary strings outside the displayed world set.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The world set contains binary strings beginning with 0, while the stated V(p) and V(q) comprehensions range over all binary prefixes and therefore include strings beginning with 1.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் மூலத்தின் மூன்று கண-வரையறைகளையும் மாற்றாமல் வைத்துக் கொண்டு, மதிப்பீடுகளை W-க்கு உட்படுத்த வேண்டிய மூலச் சிக்கலைப் பதிப்புக் குறிப்பில் பதிவு செய்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Silently intersecting both valuations with W; changing the world set to all nonempty binary strings.
records.rationale: The diagram shows only the 0-rooted tree, but the exercise may be repaired in more than one formally plausible way; retaining the formulas avoids choosing an unstated repair.
records.precise_review_question: Should a future corrected source intersect both valuation sets with W while preserving the 0-rooted world set?

records.action: Changed the filtered-model evaluation point from the original world w to its equivalence class [w].
records.source_issue_or_choice: The worlds of M* are equivalence classes, and the cited filtration theorem evaluates A at [w], but the K proof writes the raw source-model world w.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வடிகட்டப்பட்ட மாதிரியில் வாய்பாட்டைச் சமான வகுப்பு~$[w]$ இல் மதிப்பிடுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining a point that is generally not an element of W*; redefining W* to contain original worlds.
records.rationale: The preceding filtration definition sets W* to the set of classes [w], and the cited theorem states truth preservation exactly between w and [w].
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected K proof evaluate A at the filtration world [w]?

records.action: Restricted the finite countermodel enumeration to universal models, the model class used by the cited S5 completeness and finite-model results.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The decision procedure says to search all finite models, which could reject an S5 theorem merely because it fails on a non-S5 frame, while the proof conclusion correctly invokes finite universal models.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எதிர்மாதிரித் தேடலை முடிவுறு அனைத்துறவு மாதிரிகளுக்குள் மட்டுப்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Searching unrestricted finite models; adding a separate universal-frame test without naming the resulting search class.
records.rationale: S5 is complete for universal frames and has the finite-model property there, so dovetailing proofs with finite universal countermodels is sound and terminating.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected procedure enumerate exactly the finite universal models relevant to S5?

records.action: Changed all four filtered-model arrow endpoints and evaluation points from raw worlds w2 and w5 to their equivalence classes.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The paragraph explicitly discusses adding arrows to the filtered model, whose nodes the adjacent diagram labels [w_i], but then names raw w2 and w5 as endpoints and evaluation points.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வடிகட்டப்பட்ட மாதிரியின் முனைகளையும் மதிப்பீட்டுப் புள்ளிகளையும்~$[w_2]$, $[w_5]$ என்ற சமான வகுப்புகளாகவே குறிக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining raw worlds that are not generally members of W*; changing the adjacent diagram back to raw worlds.
records.rationale: A filtration has equivalence classes as worlds, and the contradiction uses truth of Box p and falsity of p at those filtered nodes.
records.precise_review_question: Are every added-arrow endpoint and both truth-evaluation points expressed as classes in the filtered model?

records.action: Reordered the three theorem conclusions to transitive, euclidean, symmetric so that each numbered statement matches the proof or exercise bearing the same number.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The theorem lists symmetric, transitive, euclidean, but proof item 1 proves transitivity, item 2 invokes Ax5 for euclideanness, and item 3 invokes AxB for symmetry.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் தேற்ற உருப்படிகளை கடத்தல், யூக்ளிடியம், சமச்சீர் என்ற நிறுவலின் வரிசையில் அமைக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Renumbering and moving the entire proof bodies; leaving every proof number attached to a different theorem claim.
records.rationale: Only the item order is defective; the set of three conclusions and all proof content remain unchanged.
records.precise_review_question: Do theorem items 1, 2 and 3 now correspond respectively to the transitivity proof, Ax5 exercise and AxB exercise?

records.action: Corrected the retained chapter metadata comment from axioms-systems to tableaux, matching the directory, chapter identifier, title, and all imported sections.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The tableaux chapter driver is headed by a copied Chapter: axioms-systems comment even though its olchapter identifier is tab and every import concerns tableaux.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இயக்கியின் அதிகாரக் குறிப்பை tableaux எனச் சரிசெய்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining metadata that identifies a different neighboring chapter.
records.rationale: This is descriptive source metadata; every structural identifier and file path independently identifies the chapter as tableaux.

records.action: Changed the BHK conjunction under discussion from A_1 and A_1 to A_1 and A_2.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The construction is the pair (N_1,N_2), and the next sentence identifies N_1 with A_1 and N_2 with A_2; only the opening conjunction repeats A_1.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இணைப்பை~$!A_1 \land !A_2$ என்று தருகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Changing N_2 and every later A_2 to A_1, which would no longer explain the general elimination rules shown above.
records.rationale: The displayed rules and BHK pair clause concern two arbitrary conjuncts.
records.precise_review_question: Does the elimination explanation begin with the general conjunction A_1 and A_2?

records.action: Proved the local clause from a local premise, then derived the global clause by applying it at every world.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The source labels the global-satisfaction conclusion as the local clause and then tries to prove the local conclusion from the stronger global premise; this reverses the proposition's two displayed claims.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முதலில் $w$ இல் உள்ளூர் நிறைவிலிருந்து $w$ இல் முடிவை நிறுவி, பின்னர் அந்த முடிவை ஒவ்வொரு $u\in W$ க்கும் பயன்படுத்தி உலகளாவிய நிறைவை நிறுவுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Preserving the reversed numbering and stronger premise, which would not prove the first displayed implication as stated.
records.rationale: The first claim is exactly the definition of semantic entailment at a world; universal application of that claim gives the second claim.
records.precise_review_question: Does the proof use the local premise for item 1 and quantify over every world only for item 2?

records.action: Called X together with its family of open sets a topological space, reserving topology for the family of open sets.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The source first says X may be written for a topology and then says X becomes a topology, although the preceding definition identifies the topology with the collection of open subsets and X with the underlying set.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் $X$ ஐ அடிப்படைக் கணமாகவும், திறந்த கணங்களின் குடும்பத்தை இடவியலாகவும், இரண்டையும் சேர்த்து இடவியல் வெளி என்றும் வேறுபடுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Using topology for both the family and the underlying set, which would erase the distinction made by the definition.
records.rationale: Standard notation distinguishes a topology from the topological space consisting of its carrier and open-set family.
records.precise_review_question: Does the prose distinguish the topology from the topological space X?

records.action: Changed both strict subset signs to non-strict subset-or-equal signs.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The source uses strict inclusion for derivability and for the set-theoretic modus-ponens property, but equality is allowed in both cases; in particular A proves A.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு இடங்களிலும் $\subseteq$ ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Preserving strict inclusion, which would falsely deny reflexive derivability when the two extensions coincide.
records.rationale: Semantic consequence corresponds to ordinary inclusion, and the implication clause guarantees a subset relation that need not be proper.
records.precise_review_question: Do both containment claims allow equality?

records.action: Removed the extra Gamma argument from the satisfaction expression for A_n.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The assumption case writes the satisfaction macro with three braced arguments although every semantic clause takes the model and formula, followed by the world argument.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நிறுவல் $!A_n$ ஐ $w$ இல் நேரடியாக நிறைவுசெய்யும் இரு-வாத மெய்ப்பாட்டு வடிவத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating Gamma as an undocumented middle macro argument, inconsistent with every other occurrence in the chapter.
records.rationale: From A_n in Gamma and satisfaction of Gamma at w, the needed conclusion is satisfaction of A_n at w.
records.precise_review_question: Does the assumption case conclude satisfaction of A_n at w with the standard macro arity?

records.action: Changed the required conclusion from A and B to the actual premise formulas B and C.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The case has derivations of B and C but asks for consequence A and B, while its last sentence correctly establishes B and C.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முடிவு முன்னுரைகளுடன் ஒத்த $!B\land !C$ என்று தருகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Renaming every premise and the final satisfaction claims to A and B.
records.rationale: Conjunction introduction combines exactly the two derived premise formulas.
records.precise_review_question: Does the semantic goal of conjunction introduction use B and C throughout?

records.action: Made the right-introduction branch conclude B or C rather than merely restating C.
records.source_issue_or_choice: After proving the left-introduction branch, the parallel right branch states only that Gamma entails C and omits the rule's disjunctive conclusion.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரண்டாம் கிளையும் $\Gamma\Entails !B\lor !C$ என்ற அதே முடிவை அடைகிறது என்று கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving the rule application implicit after the premise consequence.
records.rationale: Soundness of right disjunction introduction must establish the conclusion of the displayed rule.
records.precise_review_question: Does the C-premise branch explicitly conclude the disjunction?

records.action: Moved the world argument inside the satisfaction expression.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The first semantic case closes math mode before [w], unlike the parallel C case and every satisfaction expression around it.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் $[w]$ ஐ மெய்ப்பாட்டு வெளிப்பாட்டுக்குள்ளேயே வைக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving [w] as visually adjacent prose, which breaks the formal expression.
records.rationale: The case assumes B is true at the current world w.
records.precise_review_question: Is the world argument part of the B-satisfaction formula?

records.action: Restored singleton-set braces around B and C in the two semantic consequence premises.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The derivation premises correctly use Delta_i union singleton sets, but the semantic application later unions a set directly with a formula.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு இடங்களிலும் $\{!B\}$, $\{!C\}$ என்ற ஒருறுப்புக் கணங்களைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating formulas as sets or changing the earlier derivation premises.
records.rationale: Semantic entailment takes a set of assumptions, so the discharged case assumption must be adjoined as a singleton set.
records.precise_review_question: Do both case consequences adjoin singleton assumption sets?

records.action: Justified eventual selection of the fixed index j by the finitely many earlier indices rather than an unsupported global decrease claim.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The source says each stage leaves one fewer qualifying disjunction without restricting to the finite initial segment before j; new lower-index disjunctions can become derivable as the sets grow.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் j க்குக் கீழுள்ள முடிவுறு சுட்டெண்கள் ஒவ்வொன்றும் ஒருமுறை கையாளப்பட்ட பின் j கட்டாயம் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்படும் என்று கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Claiming a monotone decrease in the entire infinite set of pending disjunctions.
records.rationale: For a fixed j, only finitely many smaller indices can preempt it, and a handled index cannot qualify again because one disjunct has been added.
records.precise_review_question: Does the proof establish eventual treatment of j using only finitely many possible earlier preemptions?

records.action: Specified induction on the length of the extension suffix while holding the initial sequence fixed.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The source says to induct on sigma although the claim extends the one-step inclusion along the suffix taking sigma to sigma-prime.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் தொடக்கத் தொடரை நிலையாக வைத்து பின்சேர்க்கையின் நீளம் மீது தொகுமுறை செய்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Induction on the initial sequence, which does not measure the number of one-step extensions.
records.rationale: Repeated application of Delta(sigma) subset Delta(sigma.n) is controlled by the finite suffix length.
records.precise_review_question: Is the induction parameter the number of extension steps?

records.action: Supplied the omitted negation case by referring to its defined expansion as a conditional to falsity.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The induction contains an explicitly empty negation case between the atomic and conjunction cases.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மறுப்பு நிபந்தனைவாக்கம் மற்றும் பொருத்தமின்மையால் வரையறுக்கப்பட்ட சுருக்கம் என்பதால் அந்த இரண்டு நேர்வுகளிலிருந்து முடிவு பின்தொடர்கிறது என்று கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving a visibly blank proof case or duplicating the full conditional argument.
records.rationale: The syntax chapter defines negation as implication to falsity, so no independent semantic induction is required.
records.precise_review_question: Does the negation item explain why the conditional and falsity cases cover it?

records.action: Filtered by truth profiles of all subformulas and stated the induction for every subformula.
records.source_issue_or_choice: Worlds agreeing on atoms can have different accessible futures and therefore disagree on negations and implications, so quotienting only by atomic valuations does not support the claimed induction.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் A இன் எல்லாத் துணைவாய்பாடுகளிலும் மெய்மை ஒத்திசையும் உலகங்களை அடையாளப்படுத்தி, அவற்றின் மெய்மைக் கணங்களின் உட்கண உறவை அணுகுறவாகப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining the atom-profile quotient; using a more elaborate two-relation filtration although subformula-theory inclusion suffices here.
records.rationale: There are finitely many subformula truth profiles; persistence makes their inclusion a preorder, and the standard induction preserves every subformula including implication.
records.precise_review_question: Are quotient worlds full subformula truth profiles, so the implication induction has enough information about accessible futures?

records.action: Rewrote the exercise with the chapter's world-indexed satisfaction notation and the corrected subformula set.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The exercise encodes the world inside the model argument twice and still quantifies only by propositional variables after the filtration is repaired.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மெய்ப்பாட்டை மாதிரி, வாய்பாடு, உலகம் என்ற நிலையான வடிவில் எழுதி ஒவ்வொரு துணைவாய்பாட்டுக்கும் நிறுவச் சொல்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Preserving the malformed macro calls or asking only for atomic formulas, which would not finish the theorem.
records.rationale: The exercise must establish the same subformula truth lemma used in the corrected finite-model proof.
records.precise_review_question: Does the exercise state world-indexed satisfaction on both models for every filtered subformula?

records.action: Referred to the prefixed formulas as belonging to the present intuitionistic tableaux rather than to modal tableaux.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The paragraph begins by extending signed formulas for intuitionistic logic but then labels the same tableaux modal, apparently copied from the neighboring modal chapter.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இவ்வகை உள்ளுணர்வுவாத அட்டவணை மரங்களிலுள்ள வாய்பாடுகள் என்று சூழலோடு பொருந்துமாறு கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Calling the entire intuitionistic system modal solely because it uses Kripke-style prefixes.
records.rationale: The stable part, chapter and file identifiers, surrounding prose and following rules all identify intuitionistic tableaux.
records.precise_review_question: Does the prefix introduction stay within the intuitionistic-tableau context?

records.action: Changed the prose branches to false A and true B, matching the displayed true-conditional rule.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The prose says that a true conditional branches to true antecedent or false consequent, while the immediately following table correctly branches to false antecedent or true consequent.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உரை அட்டவணையிலுள்ள பொய்-A மற்றும் மெய்-B கிளைகளையே விளக்குகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Changing the table to the reversed signs, which would be semantically unsound for a true conditional.
records.rationale: At an accessible world, a true implication permits failure of the antecedent or truth of the consequent.
records.precise_review_question: Do the prose and displayed true-conditional rule have identical signs on both branches?

records.action: Made A false at the countermodel world while all premises remain true.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The opening contrapositive calls M,w a countermodel but prints A as true there, which would satisfy rather than refute the target entailment.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முன்கூற்றுகள் மெய்யாகவும் முடிவு A பொய்யாகவும் இருக்கும் வழக்கமான எதிர்மாதிரியைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Negating one of the premises instead, which would not refute entailment.
records.rationale: A countermodel to B_1,...,B_n entails A must satisfy every B_i and falsify A at the same world.
records.precise_review_question: Is A false in the countermodel used for the contrapositive?

records.action: Restored sigma on the true-falsity signed formula in the closure proof.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proposition and satisfaction premise are indexed by sigma, but its first proof sentence drops the prefix from the signed formula.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மூடல் கூற்றிலுள்ள அதே முன்னொட்டு sigma வை நிறுவலிலும் வைத்துள்ளது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating the unprefixed signed formula as a separate tableau language.
records.rationale: This chapter defines satisfiability only for prefixed signed formulas.
records.precise_review_question: Does true falsity carry sigma in both statement and proof?

records.action: Applied f to the accessible extended prefix and evaluated A at that extended world.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof's accessibility expression omits f on sigma-star, and the monotonicity conclusion repeats the starting world instead of the accessible world; the preceding sentence is also grammatically interrupted.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் பொருள்கோள் f ஐ இரு முன்னொட்டுகளுக்கும் பயன்படுத்தி, நீட்டித்த முன்னொட்டின் உலகில் A மெய் என்று முடிக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping the repeated starting-world conclusion, which cannot contradict falsity at the extension.
records.rationale: Persistence transports truth from f(sigma) to f(sigma-star), exactly the world where the false signed formula is interpreted.
records.precise_review_question: Does monotonicity carry A to f(sigma-star)?

records.action: Restored sigma on the false-disjunction premise.
records.source_issue_or_choice: Every surrounding rule case and the rule table use a prefix, but the false-disjunction exercise case omits it.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முன்னுரை வாய்பாட்டில் sigma முன்னொட்டை மீட்டமைக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving the rule application without a world name in a prefixed tableau system.
records.rationale: The semantic branch interpretation requires a prefix for every signed formula.
records.precise_review_question: Is the false disjunction indexed by sigma?

records.action: Used the two actual rule conclusions, true B and false C at sigma.n, in both extended-branch sets.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The paragraph correctly names the false-conditional rule's two conclusions and constructs a witness for them, but both set expressions instead add a false copy of the conditional at the new prefix.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு கண வெளிப்பாடுகளிலும் புதிய முன்னொட்டில் மெய்-B மற்றும் பொய்-C ஆகியவற்றைச் சேர்க்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Changing the witness construction to satisfy a false conditional at the successor, which is neither the rule conclusion nor supported by the chosen world.
records.rationale: The selected accessible witness makes B true and C false, exactly satisfying the two signed formulas generated by the rule.
records.precise_review_question: Do both extended-branch sets contain true B and false C at sigma.n?

records.action: Concluded Gamma entails A after the countermodel contradiction.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The corollary assumes Gamma proves A and aims to establish entailment, but its last line repeats the already assumed derivability claim.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முரணுக்குப் பின் துணைமுடிவின் இலக்கான பின்விளைவை முடிவாகக் கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Repeating derivability, which leaves the corollary unproved.
records.rationale: Eliminating the supposed countermodel proves Gamma entails A.
records.precise_review_question: Does the final line state entailment rather than repeat derivability?

records.action: Read ‘we earn to symbolize’ as ‘we learn to symbolize.’
records.source_issue_or_choice: The introductory sentence has the obvious typographical omission of l in learn.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் அறிமுகத் தருக்கவியல் பாடங்களில் குறியீடாக்கக் கற்கிறோம் என்று கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Translating earn literally, which is ungrammatical and contradicts the pedagogical context.
records.rationale: The sentence explains what students learn in introductory logic courses.
records.precise_review_question: Does the Tamil describe learning to symbolize conditionals?

records.action: Read ‘Another example of concerns’ as ‘Another example concerns.’
records.source_issue_or_choice: The preposition ‘of’ interrupts the grammatical subject-verb construction.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மற்றோர் எடுத்துக்காட்டு அந்த மெய்மத்தைப் பற்றியது என்று இயல்பாகக் கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Preserving an English-only grammatical accident in Tamil.
records.rationale: Removing the stray preposition restores the unique coherent reading.
records.precise_review_question: Does the paragraph introduce the tautology as another example?

records.action: Replaced the material connective by the strict connective in the negated strict-conditional comparison.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The surrounding section and the following converse direction compare the strict conditional with antecedent-and-negated-consequent, but this one line accidentally retains the material connective.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வரியில் மறுக்கப்படுவது கண்டிப்பான நிபந்தனையே.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping the material conditional, for which the displayed non-entailment is false.
records.rationale: Negating a material conditional entails A and not-B; negating a strict conditional need not do so at the current world.
records.precise_review_question: Does the non-entailment line negate A strictif B?

records.action: Restored the counterfactuals part metadata and cnt component of the stable file identifier.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The file is imported by the counterfactuals part and all neighboring files use cnt, but this file retains the older conditional-logics/con identifier.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் கோப்பு நடப்பு பகுதி மற்றும் அதன் இறக்குமதி வழிக்கேற்ப cnt ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.

records.rationale: The manifest path, part driver and cross-file identifier convention all agree on cnt.

records.source_issue_or_choice: The file is imported by the counterfactuals part and all neighboring files use cnt, but this file retains the older conditional-logics/con identifier.

records.action: Kept striking the match as the strengthened antecedent in outer space.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The first outer-space sentence says ‘light this match,’ although the displayed inference and model strengthen ‘strike this match’ by adding ‘in outer space.’
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முன்கூற்றிலும் விளக்கத்திலும் விண்வெளியில் தீக்குச்சியை உரசுவதாகவே கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Changing the antecedent to the conclusion that the match lights, which would no longer illustrate antecedent strengthening.
records.rationale: The formal pattern is p implies r versus (p and q) implies r, where p is striking and q is being in outer space.
records.precise_review_question: Is striking, rather than lighting, the action strengthened by the outer-space condition?

records.action: Removed the duplicated ‘be’ from the second premise and conclusion.
records.source_issue_or_choice: Both quoted sentences say ‘would have been be a traitor.’
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு இடங்களிலும் நாட்டுத்துரோகியாக இருந்திருப்பார் என்று இயல்பாகக் கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Representing the duplicated auxiliary as meaningful content.
records.rationale: The intended English phrase is uniquely ‘would have been a traitor.’
records.precise_review_question: Are both quoted traitor clauses grammatically complete?

records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முறைசார் குறியீடும் உரையும் இரண்டிலும் அந்தப் பொருள்சார் நிபந்தனை மெய் என்று கூறுகிறது.

records.precise_review_question: Is q material-implies r satisfied throughout S-prime?
